issues.title: Custom domain not reachable
issues.problem_statement: The customer's custom domain had been showing "site can't be reached" for three days, while the funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link but not on their own domain.

issues.title: www version of the domain showing an error page
issues.problem_statement: After the main custom domain started loading, the www version of the domain still showed an error page.

issues.title: Secure certificate (padlock) after connecting the domain
issues.problem_statement: Support noted that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after the domain is connected.

items.description: Customer opened the domain in an incognito window and still saw the same error, which support took to mean it was not a browser cache issue; the domain status in the dashboard showed Not connected.
evidence: Opened in incognito. Still the same error.
It says "Not connected" next to the domain.

items.description: Customer deleted the old A record for the domain at their domain registrar (it pointed to an old server address, which support said was blocking the connection) and added a CNAME record using the target value from their FlexiFunnels domain settings, following support's guidance; the dashboard then showed the domain as connected and the customer confirmed the domain loads.
evidence: I deleted the A record and added the CNAME. Saved.
The dashboard now shows the domain as connected.

items.description: Customer deleted a second record for the www version that pointed somewhere else and added a CNAME record for www with the same target value, following support's guidance, and confirmed that both the domain and the www version now load their funnel.
evidence: Both shop.testfunnel.example and the www version are loading our funnel now.

items.description: Support will check that the secure certificate has been issued and will message the customer if it has not.
evidence: I'll check tomorrow morning that the certificate has been issued, and I'll message you if it hasn't.

items.description: Support explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.
evidence: the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.
